description: Make a job for a small business on Instead, free. It takes applications at once through a link and QR code; the owner then publishes it to read and answer applicants by opening the publish link and signing in with their email (30 seconds). The job is public for applications as soon as it is made, under the business name, pay, hours and area given.

area.description: The neighbourhood, like Hackney or Stoke Newington

business_name.description: The business's name as customers know it

description.description: What the job is like, in the owner's words. Plain text

email.description: The owner's email, to send them the publish link and tell them when people apply

must_haves.description: What every applicant needs, like 'Weekend availability'

pay_max.description: The top of the range, if there is one

pay_min.description: The pay, or the bottom of the range

role.description: The job title, like Barista or Kitchen porter

temporary.description: True for seasonal or temporary work, like Christmas staff

name: post_job
title: Post a job
